messages.subject: hosting: proposal to move off NimbusHost
messages.body:
All,

Proposal: migrate our hosting from NimbusHost to Corvid Cloud.

- Compute is roughly 30% cheaper at Corvid for our current footprint; I modelled our GPU-free workload across their EU regions and it lands around EUR 1,400/month less at peak.
- Corvid has an EU-region residency option with data at rest and in transit confined to Amsterdam/Frankfurt. Swiftbox has been asking for exactly that in their security questionnaires.
- NimbusHost renewal is due end of March, so if we move we should start the migration by early March to avoid paying twice.

My take: we should do it, but before the v3 launch crunch, not during.

Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: RE: hosting: proposal to move off NimbusHost
messages.body:
Dear Dev,

Thank you for the detailed proposal. I have checked the numbers against our current NimbusHost invoices and your estimate of the saving appears broadly correct, although I would gently suggest we budget for one month of overlap where both providers are live, which reduces the first-quarter saving somewhat. I note the NimbusHost renewal notice requires cancellation before 15 March to avoid an automatic 12-month extension, so the timing you propose is sensible from a cash perspective.

Kind regards, Helen

Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: hosting: proposal to move off NimbusHost
messages.body: mild concern: their managed postgres is a different flavour than what we run now. extensions we use (pg_trgm is fine, but we lean on some cron jobs via pg_cron) may need re-testing. fwiw the compute side looks painless, it's the database bit i'd want a week of staging time for.

messages.subject: RE: hosting: proposal to move off NimbusHost
messages.body:
ok. druk met redline nu, dev lead.

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: hosting: proposal to move off NimbusHost
messages.body:
Confirmed, we're going with Corvid Cloud.

Plan:
- Send NimbusHost cancellation before 15 March
- Staging environment on Corvid first week of March (addresses Jonas's pg_cron concern)
- App tier + managed Postgres move in March, well before the v3 launch
- I'll circulate a runbook before we touch production

Cheers, Dev
